description: This JavaScript file implements the function get_html_translation_table, which generates an HTML entity translation table based on specified tables and quote styles. It is part of the php.js project, providing PHP functions in JavaScript, and contains extensive copyright and attribution information.

methods.name: get_html_translation_table(table, quote_style)
methods.description: Generates an object mapping symbols to their corresponding HTML entities based on the specified translation table and quote style.
